arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The government contends the Leadership Act targets the HIV/AIDS pandemic. It asserts the policy applies to entities sharing a name and logo with the domestic recipient.
The nonprofit argues the record shows its foreign affiliates suffer First Amendment harms. It claims the policy forces them to adopt a specific viewpoint.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case involves a conflict over the scope of a federal anti-prostitution policy. The government argues the policy applies broadly to affiliates. The nonprofit argues the policy violates free speech rights of its foreign partners.
